messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99-detector triggered for /v1/stream (prod). p95=0.73s p99=3.84s. Region: us-west-2. Pager: oncall-jonathan. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/realtime-p99

oncall-jonathan: on it. jumping in, starting quick triage. maya, can you pull the dashboards?

maya_ops: charts -> https://dash/realtime/streaming?range=5m. spike starts ~5791229940. concurrent streams +30%. p99 concentrated on seq_len>1024. a couple hosts show p99~9s.

casey_eng: scanning logs now — seeing repeated backpressure warnings and `stream_send_timeout`. also spikes in `grpc.stream.send` latency around same hosts. suspect degraded kernel path after recent rollout.

oncall-jonathan: checklist: 1) verify rollout status 2) check fallback policy + model variants 3) attempt route-shift to standby pool. casey, can you try to reproduce with a short curl?

casey_eng: running quick repro...

casey_eng: ```
curl -i -X POST https://api.prod/v1/stream -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-large","input":"test","stream":true}'
```

casey_eng: result: server accepts then stalls after initial data chunk for ~7s, then resumes. consistent with tail stalls.

luis_support: support queue: 8 live sessions reporting slow responses. Latency-SLO dashboard flagged 3 enterprise customers (acct: acme-co, beta-ml, delta-ops). They're seeing stalled streaming responses.

oncall-jonathan: mitigation plan (quick): a) shift traffic from pool-A -> pool-B (standby) b) lower circuit-breaker thresholds to fail fast for heavy seqs c) rollback the recent quantization kernel rollout on pool-A d) page eng-sre for route-shift help.

eng-sre: ack. prepping route-shift. will coordinate traffic move and watch for error-rate regressions.

casey_eng: checked rollout metadata: roll-id=roll-2026-03-12-quant applied to pool-A. initiating rollback on pool-A now. ETA ~90s.

incident-bot: Action logged: rollback started by casey_eng (roll-2026-03-12-quant) at 5791230020.

maya_ops: monitoring: 60s after rollback p99 dropped to ~1.8s, 120s after rollback p99 ~1.1s. tail stalls mostly cleared, persistent minor tail at seq_len>2048.

oncall-jonathan: good catch. keep monitoring for 15m. casey, please file a follow-up RCA ticket for quantization kernel mismatch and perf traces. include perf counters and candidate host IDs.

casey_eng: filed INC-579123-quant-regress with logs + perf traces + flamegraphs. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

luis_support: notifying affected customers now with status update and expected follow-up.

eng-sre: will keep the page open and re-evaluate in 30m. leaving note in incident log and schedule post-incident review.

oncall-jonathan: :thumbsup: closing immediate mitigation. thanks everyone for fast response.
